CheckTitle: Prevent brute-force lockout from unknown devices is enabled
Description: Checks the Attack Protection user-lockout setting for unknown devices.
Risk: Without this protection, attackers can cause account lockouts from unknown devices during brute-force attempts.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, review password and attack-protection settings for unknown-device lockout protection.
2. Enable the setting that prevents brute-force lockout from unknown devices.
3. Ensure self-service account unlock is available for legitimate users who need a new device.
4. Monitor System Log events for lockouts and failed sign-in spikes after enabling the control.

Recommendation.Text: Enable unknown-device brute-force lockout protection to reduce account lockout denial-of-service from unfamiliar devices.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
